name: shipbuilding-village-storm
reviewNotes: All 53 source records reviewed. Raw source records retain physical offsets through the draft compiler; preserve storm, recovery and shipwright-rescue branches.
Keep the western mountain route, northeast sparrow inn route by ship, and the distinction between unsealable oni physical attacks and sealable spells.
Records 23/24 explicitly say 海すら独占: monopolize even the sea. Preserve Fujin/Raijin's coerced attacks, recruitment alternatives and cleansing rain.
